It accepts text, images, video, and documents, with tool calling and structured outputs for building responsive applications.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemini 4 Neon (Fast)
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Gemini 4 Neon is Google's fast multimodal reasoning model for coding, agentic workflows, and complex tasks, delivering high-quality results with low latency. It accepts text, images, video, and documents, with tool calling and structured outputs for building responsive applications.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemini Decision 1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Gemini Decisions is Google's evaluation model for classification, routing, and scoring. It answers structured questions with Boolean probabilities, choices, and scores, returning confidence values and probability distributions to help applications interpret the results. Developers can use it to triage support requests, categorize content, and evaluate inputs against defined criteria.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemini Embedding 001
vercel-ai-gateway.description: State-of-the-art embedding model with excellent performance across English, multilingual and code tasks.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemini Embedding 2
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Google’s first fully multimodal Embedding model that is capable of mapping text, image, video, audio, and PDFs and their interleaved combinations thereof into a single, unified vector space. Built on the Gemini architecture, it supports 100+ languages.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 is optimized for image understanding and generation and offers a balance of price and performance.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is Google’s multimodal model for video generation and visual content creation. It combines text, image, and video inputs with text and video outputs, helping developers build creative applications that work across multiple media formats.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemini Omni Flash Preview
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Gemini Omni Flash (Preview) is a multimodal model designed for video, image, and text tasks. It is optimized for video generation, offering video output alongside text responses in a single model.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on small models) and generating text output. This release includes open-weights models in both pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants. Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Gemma 4 31B IT
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Gemma 4 31B is engineered to tackle the most demanding enterprise workloads and complex reasoning tasks. With an expansive 256K-token context window, the 31B model can effortlessly ingest entire codebases, and massive sets of images in a single prompt.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Text Embedding 005
vercel-ai-gateway.description: English-focused text embedding model optimized for code and English language tasks.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Text Multilingual Embedding 002
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Multilingual text embedding model optimized for cross-lingual tasks across many languages.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Veo 3.1 Fast Generate
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Veo 3.1 Fast is a specialized, high-speed variant of Google DeepMind’s Veo 3.1 text-to-video model, optimized for rapid generation of 8-second, high-fidelity videos. It is designed to create cinematic, 1080p, or 720p content with improved prompt adherence and native audio, making it ideal for creating quick, high-quality video clips, social media content, and ad creatives.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Veo 3.1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Veo 3.1 is Google's state-of-the-art model for generating high-fidelity, 8-second 720p, 1080p or 4k videos featuring stunning realism and natively generated audio.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Veo 3.1 Lite Generate
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Veo 3.1 Lite Preview is a high-efficiency, developer-first video model providing high-fidelity video generation, editing, and cinematic control. It leverages the state-of-the-art Veo 3.1 model to democratize professional-grade video AI by offering a scalable, programmable interface for creators and enterprises.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: HeyGen Decision 1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: HeyGen Decision 1 is HeyGen's decision model for classification, routing, and scoring. It evaluates text, structured JSON, up to four images, and one video against yes/no questions, custom choices, and ordered rubrics, returning typed answers with probabilities. It answers up to 400 questions over shared content per request with a 128K context window.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: HeyGen Decision 1 Turbo
vercel-ai-gateway.description: HeyGen Decision 1 Turbo is a lower-cost, longer-context variant of HeyGen Decision 1 for high-volume classification, routing, and scoring. It evaluates text, structured JSON, up to four images, and one video against yes/no questions, custom choices, and ordered rubrics, returning typed answers with probabilities. It supports a 256K context window and is in preview.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: HeyGen Video
vercel-ai-gateway.description: HeyGen Video generates 5–15 second clips with synchronized dialogue, ambience, and sound effects from text, a first-frame image, or image and video references. It supports 480p, 768p, 1080p, and 2K output. Reference mode charges for input video seconds plus output video seconds; image and audio references have no additional charge.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ampersand v0.1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ampersand v0.1 is a collaborator model from Humans& for shared goals, group conversations, and long-running collaboration. Its Responses API supports text, reasoning, client-side function tools, and implicit prompt caching.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mercury 3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mercury 3 is Inception’s most capable model for agentic workflows and real-time applications. It is one of the world’s fastest models, powered by diffusion.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ling 3.0 Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ling 3.0 Flash is designed with token efficiency and production-scale agentic inference as key priorities, enabling developers to complete more useful work within constrained token, latency, and serving-cost budgets.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin is InclusionAI’s finance-enhanced MoE language model, combining 124 billion total parameters with approximately 5.1 billion active parameters for efficient financial reasoning. Its 256K context window, function calling, and support for complex, multi-step investment workflows make it ideal for financial research, analysis, long-horizon planning, and execution, while retaining strong capabilities in coding and mathematics.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ling 3.0 Flash Sante
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ling-3.0-Flash-Sante is inclusionAI’s language model specialized for health and medicine, built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 124 billion total parameters and approximately 5.1 billion active per token. With a 256K context window and function calling, it supports medical knowledge reasoning, evidence-based retrieval, and complex medical workflows while retaining general reasoning, coding, and agentic capabilities.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ling 3.0 Flash VL
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ling 3.0 Flash VL builds on Ling 3.0 Flash with stronger language capabilities, native visual perception, and visual agent capabilities. It supports text, image, and video inputs with text output, reasoning, and function calling.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ling 3.1 Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ling 3.1 Flash is InclusionAI's hybrid reasoning language model for coding, multi-step analysis, and tool-using agents. It has 560B total parameters with 25B activated parameters and supports long-context text workflows.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ling 3.1 Flash 1019
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 is InclusionAI's updated hybrid reasoning language model for coding, multi-step analysis, and tool-using agents. Its mixture-of-experts architecture has 560B total parameters with 25B active per token, and its 1M-token context window supports long-document analysis and extended agentic workflows.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Schematron V2 Small
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Schematron V2 Small is a specialized model from Inference.net for extracting structured data from HTML. It uses a supplied JSON Schema to produce conforming JSON and is designed for complex schemas and long pages.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Schematron V2 Turbo
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Schematron V2 Turbo is a specialized model from Inference.net for extracting structured data from HTML. It uses a supplied JSON Schema to produce conforming JSON and is optimized for high-throughput extraction.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Interfaze Beta
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Interfaze is an AI model built on a new architecture that merges specialized DNN/CNN models with LLMs for developer tasks that require deterministic output and high consistency like OCR, scraping, classification, STT and more.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v2.5 Turbo Image-to-Video
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Kling 2.5 Turbo is a major update to the AI video generation model focused on significantly improving speed, video quality, temporal stability, and creative control for creators, making professional-grade AI-generated video faster, more coherent, and easier to direct from text prompts.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v2.5 Turbo Text-to-Video
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Kling 2.5 Turbo is a major update to the AI video generation model focused on significantly improving speed, video quality, temporal stability, and creative control for creators, making professional-grade AI-generated video faster, more coherent, and easier to direct from text prompts.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v2.6 Image-to-Video
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Kling 2.6 introduces a groundbreaking "Native Audio" capability, enabling the generation of complete videos in a single go, including natural voice, action sound effects, and environmental ambient sounds, providing an immersive "what you see if what you hear" experience.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v2.6 Motion Control
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Kling 2.6 introduces a groundbreaking "Native Audio" capability, enabling the generation of complete videos in a single go, including natural voice, action sound effects, and environmental ambient sounds, providing an immersive "what you see if what you hear" experience.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v2.6 Text-to-Video
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Kling 2.6 introduces a groundbreaking "Native Audio" capability, enabling the generation of complete videos in a single go, including natural voice, action sound effects, and environmental ambient sounds, providing an immersive "what you see if what you hear" experience.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v3.0 Image-to-Video
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Build upon an All-in-One product framework, the Kling 3.0 model series supports full multimodal input and output spanning text, images, audio, and video, bringing the understanding, generation, and editing of video together in one streamlined AI workflow. The models integrate multiple tasks, including text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, and in-video editing, into a single, native multimodal architecture, enabling the models to follow complex narrative logic, deliver precise shot control, and maintain strong prompt adherence.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v3.0 Motion Control
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Kling 3.0 delivers a major leap in character fidelity for motion-driven generation, with stable facial features across multi-angle and long-duration motion, accurate complex emotions from multi-image face references, identity preservation through partial occlusions (hats, hands, fans), and steady clarity as the camera zooms, pans, or tracks.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kling v3.0 Text-to-Video
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Build upon an All-in-One product framework, the Kling 3.0 model series supports full multimodal input and output spanning text, images, audio, and video, bringing the understanding, generation, and editing of video together in one streamlined AI workflow. The models integrate multiple tasks, including text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, and in-video editing, into a single, native multimodal architecture, enabling the models to follow complex narrative logic, deliver precise shot control, and maintain strong prompt adherence.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Liquid d1.2
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Liquid d1.2 is a decision model for classification, routing, and scoring across text and images. It answers typed yes/no, multiple-choice, and scale questions about shared state in a single forward pass and returns structured answers with calibrated probabilities, without generating output tokens.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Liquid d1.2 Ultra
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Liquid d1.2-ultra is Liquid AI's most accurate decision model for classification, routing, and scoring across text and images. It answers typed yes/no, multiple-choice, and scale questions in a single forward pass and returns calibrated probabilities without generating output tokens, for demanding tasks such as document review and visual inspection.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: LFM2.5-24B-A2B
vercel-ai-gateway.description: LFM2.5-24B-A2B is a text-generation model from Liquid AI with a 128,000-token context window.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: LongCat 2.5
vercel-ai-gateway.description: LongCat 2.5 is Meituan’s native multimodal model for coding and long-running agent workflows. It combines visual understanding with multi-step reasoning and tool use to work across complex codebases and full-project development. Its 1M-token context window supports tasks involving large documents, codebases, and text and image inputs.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct
vercel-ai-gateway.description: An update to Meta Llama 3 70B Instruct that includes an expanded 128K context length, multilinguality and improved reasoning capabilities.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
vercel-ai-gateway.description: An update to Meta Llama 3 8B Instruct that includes an expanded 128K context length, multilinguality and improved reasoning capabilities.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Where performance meets efficiency. This model supports high-performance conversational AI designed for content creation, enterprise applications, and research, offering advanced language understanding capabilities, including text summarization, classification, sentiment analysis, and code generation.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Llama 4 Maverick 17B Instruct
vercel-ai-gateway.description: As a general purpose LLM, Llama 4 Maverick contains 17 billion active parameters, 128 experts, and 400 billion total parameters, offering high quality at a lower price compared to Llama 3.3 70B.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Llama 4 Scout 17B Instruct
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Llama 4 Scout is the best multimodal model in the world in its class and is more powerful than our Llama 3 models, while fitting in a single H100 GPU. Additionally, Llama 4 Scout supports an industry-leading context window of up to 10M tokens.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Ember
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Muse Ember is Meta’s multimodal language model for conversational, reasoning, and agentic applications. It supports text and image understanding, tool calling, structured outputs, and document input, with a 1,048,576-token context window for working with large prompts and extended conversations. Implicit prompt caching supports reuse of shared input across requests.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Image 1.0
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Muse Image is the first image generation model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, it uses advanced reasoning to understand complex prompts, seamlessly blending multiple photos into high-quality creations you can download and share anywhere.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Spark 1.1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Muse Spark 1.1 is strongest at agentic performance, tool use, and computer use. It does well on long-running tasks with 1M token context window, can delegate execution to sub-agents running in parallel, and is trained to use computer interfaces on desktop, mobile, or browser.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Spark 1.2
vercel-ai-gateway.description: A coding-optimized model purpose-built for agentic workflows. Improvements to code generation, debugging, and codebase understanding — with a 1M context window that handles your entire project in one session.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor
vercel-ai-gateway.description: A coding-optimized model with pricing designed for builders. Same model, same capabilities — up to 95% less than Standard. Your inputs and outputs are used to train and improve Meta's AI models.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Spark 1.3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta’s multimodal reasoning model for long-horizon agentic and coding workflows. With a 1M-token context window, reliable tool calling, higher first-attempt accuracy, and native understanding of video, images, and documents, it helps developers build capable coding agents and AI development workflows with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor is Meta’s cost-optimized API option for agentic coding workflows. It offers a 1M-token context window, dependable tool calling, and multimodal perception at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.20 per million output tokens, with usage permitted to improve Meta’s products.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Spark Open
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Muse Spark Open is Meta’s open-weight reasoning model for coding and agentic workflows. Its sparse mixture-of-experts architecture has 816 billion total parameters with approximately 42 billion active per token, combining code generation, tool use, and image understanding. A one-million-token context window supports repository analysis, multi-file changes, debugging, and long-running agent tasks. This provider also documents audio and video input with text output.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Muse Wonder
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Muse Wonder is Meta’s model for frontier coding, long-running agents, and advanced computer use. It plans long tasks, delegates work to sub-agents, and recovers from errors.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Decision-1.1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Microsoft Decision-1.1 is a text decision model from Microsoft AI for classification, routing, and evaluation. It answers yes/no questions, selects among predefined options, and scores inputs against custom criteria, returning calibrated probabilities and confidence values. With support for multiple questions per request and a 32,768-token context window, it helps developers triage support requests, guide automated workflows, and evaluate AI responses against a rubric.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Image-2.6
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MAI-Image-2.6 is a diffusion-based generative model designed for both high-quality text-to-image synthesis and precise, controllable image-to-image editing. It progressively transforms random noise into a coherent image aligned with a given text prompt, leveraging a flow-matching loss to learn a continuous transformation between the noise distribution and the data distribution. MAI-Image-2.6 excels at precise, surgical edits with consistency - enabling users and developers to make targeted object edits, adapt layouts, update text, clean up artifacts like motion blur, and preserve visual consistency across iterations.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Image-2.6-Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MAI-Image-2.6 is a diffusion-based generative model designed for both high-quality text-to-image synthesis and precise, controllable image-to-image editing. It progressively transforms random noise into a coherent image aligned with a given text prompt, leveraging a flow-matching loss to learn a continuous transformation between the noise distribution and the data distribution. MAI-Image-2.6 excels at precise, surgical edits with consistency - enabling users and developers to make targeted object edits, adapt layouts, update text, clean up artifacts like motion blur, and preserve visual consistency across iterations.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Image-2.7
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MAI-Image-2.7 is Microsoft AI's diffusion model for text-to-image generation and precise image editing, with output up to 2048x2048 and transparent backgrounds.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Image-2.7-Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: A faster, lower-cost variant of MAI-Image-2.7 with the same generation and editing capabilities, including output up to 2048x2048 and transparent backgrounds.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Transcribe 2
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MAI-Transcribe 2 is a multilingual speech-to-text model from Microsoft AI, ranked #1 on the FLEURS multilingual benchmark. It supports 60 languages with automatic language identification, code switching for mixed-language speech, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, keyword biasing for domain-specific terminology, and configurable verbatim or clean transcription styles. It is suited for captions, call transcription, subtitling, accessibility, and other voice-enabled applications, and is faster than MAI-Transcribe-1.5 on long-form audio.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming is a low-latency, "speech in, text out" realtime transcription API. Audio can be sent to the model as a continuous stream over a WebSocket connection and transcripts are returned incrementally as the speaker talks, with no need to wait for the utterance to finish. Intermediate results (aka Partials) update the current transcription; final results confirm a segment.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Voice-2
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Microsoft AI's highest-fidelity text-to-speech model, with expressive multilingual voices and consistent speakers across long-form narration. Served through Azure Speech (preview).

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Voice-2-Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Microsoft AI's low-latency text-to-speech model for voice agents and assistants, with the expressive multilingual voices of MAI-Voice-2 at twice the speed.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Voice-2.1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MAI-Voice-2.1 is our highest-fidelity, most expressive text-to-speech model, delivering rich, natural speech across 23 languages. It extends the MAI-Voice family with broad multilingual coverage, gated instant voice cloning, and strong long-form generation capabilities. With its detailed prosody, nuanced expressiveness, and studio-grade audio quality, MAI-Voice-2.1 is ideal for experiences where maximum voice quality and fidelity are required - long-form narration, brand-defining audio etc.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash is a text-to-speech model built for fast, low-latency generation. It produces high- fidelity, natural, and expressive speech across 23 languages and supports gated instant voice cloning, all while being optimized for real-time responsiveness. Its human-like intonation, rhythm, and emotional nuance make it ideal for voice agents, assistants, and other interactive scenarios where latency and cost are critical.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Decision-1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Microsoft Decision-1 is a text decision model from Microsoft AI for classification, routing, and evaluation. It answers yes/no questions, selects among predefined options, and scores inputs against custom criteria, returning calibrated probabilities and confidence values. With support for multiple questions per request and a 32,768-token context window, it helps developers triage support requests, guide automated workflows, and evaluate AI responses against a rubric.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax H3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: H3 is a next-generation open-weights, general-purpose multimodal video model. Rather than being limited to specialized tasks such as generating, editing, or referencing, H3 understands multimodal contexts that bring together text, images, video, and audio. This enables it to interpret creative intent in a unified way and deliver more natural, coherent generation and expression.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax H3 Image
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MiniMax H3 Image generates images from text and edits images using up to 16 reference images. It supports custom dimensions and aspect ratios, outputs up to 20 megapixels, and JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax H3 Image Highspeed
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MiniMax H3 Image Highspeed is the faster variant of MiniMax H3 Image for text-to-image generation and image editing. It supports up to 16 reference images, custom dimensions and aspect ratios, outputs up to 20 megapixels, and JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax H3 Max
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MiniMax H3 Max is a next-generation general-purpose multimodal video model ranking #1 for overall quality, prompt understanding, and aesthetics in all evaluations, while generating a 5-second video in under 3 seconds.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax M2.1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MiniMax 2.1 is MiniMax's latest model, optimized specifically for robustness in coding, tool use, instruction following, and long-horizon planning.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax M2.5
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MiniMax M2.5 is an agent-native frontier model trained explicitly to reason efficiently, decompose tasks optimally, and complete complex workflows under real-world time and cost constraints. It achieves task completion speeds comparable to or faster than leading proprietary frontier models by combining high inference throughput with reinforcement learning focused on token-efficient reasoning and better decision-making in agentic scaffolds. M2.5 is well-suited for production agents handling full-stack software projects, research and analysis workflows, long-horizon planning, and multi-tool orchestration, delivering intelligence for organizations that need both high-quality reasoning and predictable, low latency.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax M2.7
vercel-ai-gateway.description: M2.7 delivers outstanding performance in real-world software engineering, including end-to-end full project delivery, log analysis and bug troubleshooting, code security, machine learning, and more.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax M3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MiniMax-M3 is a frontier-class foundation model that unites the three capabilities defining today's frontier: a 1M-token context window, frontier coding and agentic performance, and native multimodality — the first open-weight model to deliver all three in a single system.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is MiniMax's M-series language model for agent reasoning, tool use, coding, and long-context tasks, with a 1,000,000-token context window. Compared with MiniMax-M3, it adds always-on reasoning and adjustable reasoning effort, allowing developers to tune reasoning effort for different tasks.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mistral Codestral
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mistral's cutting-edge language model for coding released end of July 2025, Codestral specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM), code correction and test generation.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Codestral Embed
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Code embedding model that can embed code databases and repositories to power coding assistants.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ministral 14B
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Ministral 3 14B is the largest model in the Ministral 3 family, offering state-of-the-art capabilities and performance comparable to its larger Mistral Small 3.2 24B counterpart. Optimized for local deployment, it delivers high performance across diverse hardware, including local setups.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ministral 3B
vercel-ai-gateway.description: A compact, efficient model for on-device tasks like smart assistants and local analytics, offering low-latency performance.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Ministral 8B
vercel-ai-gateway.description: A more powerful model with faster, memory-efficient inference, ideal for complex workflows and demanding edge applications.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mistral Embed
vercel-ai-gateway.description: General-purpose text embedding model for semantic search, similarity, clustering, and RAG workflows.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mistral Large 3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mistral Large 3 2512 is Mistral’s most capable model to date. It has a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with 41B active parameters (675B total).

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mistral Large 4
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mistral Large 4 is Mistral AI's open-weight, natively multimodal model, available in public preview with 1.05 trillion total parameters and 49 billion active parameters. It leads aggregated benchmarks among open-weight models from the US and Europe, with strengths in cyber defense, manufacturing, finance, and visual grounding. This model uses the latest weights from Mistral.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mistral Medium Latest
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mistral's frontier-class multimodal model optimized for agentic and coding use cases.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mistral Nemo 12B
vercel-ai-gateway.description: 12B model trained jointly by Mistral AI and NVIDIA, it significantly outperforms existing models smaller or similar in size.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mistral Small
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mistral Small currently runs Mistral Small 4, a multimodal model combining instruction following, reasoning, and coding with a 262,144-token context window.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Fast, cost-efficient multilingual transcription with speaker diarization and vocabulary biasing, designed for high-volume audio processing.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Voxtral TTS 3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Generates natural, expressive speech with preset or cloned voices and inline controls for emotion and pace.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mistral’s flagship transcription model, optimized for multilingual accuracy, speaker diarization, and domain-specific vocabulary.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Toast 1
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Built for knowledge-intensive questions, multi-step retrieval, and evidence synthesis. Toast 1 can work with any backend exposed through function calling.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Mo
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Mo is Modaic's System One decision model for zero-shot judgments over text, JSON, and images. It answers boolean, choice, and score questions with typed answers, per-option probabilities, and calibrated confidence, supporting classification, routing, rubric scoring, and review workflows. It reads a 262,144-token context and up to four images per request.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Kimi K2 Instruct
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Kimi K2 is a state-of-the-art mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. vercel-ai-gateway.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super 120B A12B

Additionally, a long context window gives the model long-term memory, preventing AI agents from losing focus on long, multi-step tasks and ensuring high-accuracy results. Fully open with weights, datasets, and recipes, Super allows easy customization and secure deployment anywhere.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free

vercel-ai-gateway.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Nvidia Nemotron Nano 9B V2

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Step 5 Preview
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Step 5 Preview is StepFun’s flagship AI model for agentic coding, professional knowledge work, and financial analysis. Built on a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 600B total parameters and 27B active per token, it combines a 1M-token context window with vision input. From building interactive applications and debugging code to conducting research and producing analytical reports, it supports complex workflows that require sustained reasoning, tool use, and iterative refinement.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Tencent Hy-MT2-Lite
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Hy-MT2-Lite is Tencent Cloud Hunyuan’s lightweight 1.8B translation model, combining efficient performance with an 8K-token context window and broad multilingual coverage. It supports translation across 33 languages and five ethnic Chinese and dialect variants, delivering strong results on benchmarks including FLORES-200 and WMT25. Designed for professional and real-world business use, it reliably follows instructions for structured, delimiter-preserving, context-aware, glossary-guided, and style-specific translation.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Tencent Hy-MT2-Plus
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Hy-MT2-Plus is Tencent Cloud Hunyuan’s 7B translation model, offering an 8K-token context window and broad multilingual coverage. Optimized for translation across 33 languages and five ethnic Chinese and dialect variants, it delivers industry-leading performance on benchmarks including FLORES-200 and WMT25. It excels in professional domains and real-world business scenarios, with strong instruction-following for structured, delimiter-preserving, context-aware, glossary-guided, and style-specific translation.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Tencent Hy-MT2-Pro
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Hy-MT2-Pro is Tencent Cloud Hunyuan’s flagship translation model, featuring 30B-A3B parameters and an 8K-token context window. It delivers bidirectional translation across 33 core language pairs, plus five minority-language and dialect pairs. With industry-leading performance on FLORES-200 and WMT25, it excels in specialized domains and real-world business scenarios while supporting structured, contextual, terminology-aware, style-specific, and delimiter-preserving translation.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Tencent Hy3
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Built for real-world business scenarios, Hy3 features a 295B/21B active MoE architecture, native 256K context support, and three reasoning modes. It enhances coding, long-form comprehension, multi-turn dialogue, and agentic task execution, balancing reliability, efficiency, and cost across both high-frequency interactions and complex workflows.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Tencent Hy4
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Tencent Hy4 is a text model for coding, reasoning, and agentic workflows. It supports tool calling, structured outputs, and prompt caching, with a 1M-token context window for tasks such as software engineering, document analysis, and office automation.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Tencent Hy4 Flash
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Tencent Hy4 Flash is a lower-cost model in the Hy4 family for coding, reasoning, and agentic workflows. It supports deep reasoning with preserved thinking, tool calling, structured outputs, prompt caching, and image understanding, with a 1M-token context window.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Tencent Hy4 Preview
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Tencent Hy4 preview is Tencent Hy’s open-source large language model, featuring 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. Built for real-world productivity, it supports long-horizon coding, cross-document analysis, office content creation, game development, and scientific reasoning, making it well-suited to complex agents and multi-step professional workflows.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Inkling
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Inkling is a multimodal MoE model (975B total, 41B active, 256k context) reasoning over text, image, and audio inputs.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Inkling 2 Mini
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines Lab's small multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model, with 26.4 billion total parameters and 3.4 billion active per token. Its looped architecture runs the middle layers three times per token for stronger reasoning at low cost, and it accepts text and image input with a 1M-token context window.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Inkling 2 Small
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Inkling 2 Small is Thinking Machines Lab’s second-generation multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model, with 594 billion total parameters and 17 billion active per token. It combines text and image understanding with controllable reasoning for coding, tool use, and professional knowledge work.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Inkling Small
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Inkling-Small is a lighter-weight model with 12B active parameters, trained with a similar recipe, to Inkling that achieves strong performance with even lower cost and latency.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Proteus
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Proteus is Topaz Labs’ video enhancement model for detail-preserving upscaling, denoising, and restoration. It enhances an existing video with automatic adjustments or fine control over detail recovery, compression artifacts, noise, blur, and grain. An input video and output resolution are required, supporting workflows that improve footage quality while preserving its source characteristics.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Starlight Precise 2.6
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Starlight Precise 2.6 is Topaz Labs’ generative video enhancement model for upscaling and restoration with high fidelity. It improves faces, textures, and fine details while maintaining temporal consistency across frames. An input video and accurate source metadata are required, making it suited to refining generated footage and restoring archival video for higher-resolution delivery.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Wonder 3.5
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Wonder 3.5 is Topaz Labs’ image enhancement model for generative upscaling and detail recovery. It repairs and enhances an existing JPEG, PNG, or TIFF image, with controls for enhancement strength, output dimensions, and grain. An input image is required, making it suited to restoring low-quality photos and refining images for larger displays or print.

vercel-ai-gateway.name: Jev
vercel-ai-gateway.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI’s System One decision model for fast, structured decisions in software. It evaluates shared state against typed questions and returns choices, scores, and boolean probabilities, supporting classification, routing, rubric-based assessment, and automated verification. Multiple questions can be evaluated in parallel within a single request.

volcengine.name: GLM-4.7
volcengine.description: GLM-4.7 is the latest flagship model from Zhipu AI. GLM-4.7 enhances coding capabilities, long-term task planning, and tool collaboration for Agentic Coding scenarios, achieving leading performance among open-source models in multiple public benchmarks. General capabilities are improved, with more concise and natural responses, and more immersive writing. In complex agent tasks, instruction following is stronger during tool calls, and the aesthetics of Artifacts and Agentic Coding frontend, as well as long-term task completion efficiency, are further enhanced. • Stronger programming capabilities: Significantly improved multi-language coding and terminal agent performance; GLM-4.7 can now implement "think first, then act" mechanisms in programming frameworks like Claude Code, Kilo Code, TRAE, Cline, and Roo Code, with more stable performance on complex tasks. • Frontend aesthetics improvement: GLM-4.7 shows significant progress in frontend generation quality, capable of generating websites, PPTs, and posters with better visual appeal. • Stronger tool calling capabilities: GLM-4.7 enhances tool calling abilities, scoring 67 in BrowseComp web task evaluation; achieving 84.7 in τ²-Bench interactive tool calling evaluation, surpassing Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the open-source SOTA. • Reasoning capability improvement: Significantly enhanced math and reasoning abilities, scoring 42.8% in the HLE ("Humanity's Last Exam") benchmark, a 41% improvement over GLM-4.6, surpassing GPT-5.1. • General capability enhancement: GLM-4.7 conversations are more concise, intelligent, and humane; writing and role-playing are more literary and immersive.

Its foundational abilities have been significantly upgraded, achieving strong performance on benchmark evaluations. wenxin.name: ERNIE 5.1
wenxin.description: ERNIE 5.1 is the latest model in the ERNIE series, featuring comprehensive upgrades to its foundational capabilities. It demonstrates significant improvements in areas such as agents, knowledge processing, reasoning, and deep search. This release adopts a decoupled fully asynchronous reinforcement learning architecture, specifically designed to address key challenges in the evolution of large models toward autonomous agent decision-making, including training–inference numerical discrepancies, low utilization of heterogeneous computing resources, and global issues caused by long-tail effects. In addition, large-scale agent post-training techniques are employed to further enhance the model’s capabilities and generalization performance. Through a three-stage collaborative framework involving environment, expert, and fusion processes, the approach not only ensures training efficiency but also significantly improves the model’s stability and performance on complex tasks.

xiaomi.name: MiMo-V2.5
xiaomi.description: MiMo-V2.5 is a native omni-modal Agent foundation model that understands images, video, audio, and text in a unified architecture, with a 1M context window. It delivers Pro-level agentic performance at roughly half the inference cost of MiMo-V2.5-Pro, with improved multimodal perception over MiMo-V2-Omni. Its built-in agentic capabilities (browsing, understanding, reasoning, execution) and faster inference make it well-suited to latency-sensitive and multi-step agent frameworks such as OpenClaw.

xiaomi.name: MiMo-V2.5 Pro
xiaomi.description: MiMo-V2.5-Pro is Xiaomi's most capable flagship model to date, delivering significant improvements in general agentic capabilities, complex software engineering, and long-horizon tasks. It retains the 1T total / 42B active hybrid-attention architecture with a 1M context window, and can sustain complex long-horizon tasks spanning more than a thousand tool calls. Performance on demanding agentic benchmarks (ClawEval, GDPVal, SWE-bench Pro) is comparable to Claude Opus 4.6.

zhipuai.description: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal GLM-5 model. It inherits the GLM-5.3 text contract with always-on thinking, adds image and video understanding, and lands coding quality close to the flagship at roughly one-tenth of the price.

zhipuai.name: GLM-5V-Turbo
zhipuai.description: GLM-5V-Turbo is Zhipu’s multimodal Coding foundation model for visual programming tasks. It natively handles images, video, text, and files, and is optimized for long-horizon planning, complex coding, and agent execution in multimodal workflows.

zhipuai.name: GLM-Image
zhipuai.description: GLM-Image is Zhipu’s new flagship image generation model. The model was trained end-to-end on domestically produced chips and adopts an original hybrid architecture that combines autoregressive modeling with a diffusion decoder. This design enables strong global instruction understanding alongside fine-grained local detail rendering, overcoming long-standing challenges in generating knowledge-dense content such as posters, presentations, and educational diagrams. It represents an important exploration toward a new generation of “cognitive generative” technology paradigms, exemplified by Nano Banana Pro.

zhipuai.name: Vidu 2 Image
zhipuai.description: Vidu 2 is a video generation foundation model designed to balance speed and quality. It focuses on image-to-video generation and start–end frame control, supporting 4-second videos at 720P resolution. The generation speed is significantly improved while costs are substantially reduced. Image-to-video generation fixes previous color shift issues, delivering stable and controllable visuals suitable for e-commerce and similar applications. In addition, semantic understanding of start and end frames and consistency across multiple reference images have been enhanced, making it an efficient tool for large-scale content production in general entertainment, internet media, animated short dramas, and advertising.

It produces content with fixed specifications of 5 seconds, 24 FPS, and 1080P resolution. Through deep optimization of visual clarity, the overall image quality and texture are significantly improved, while issues such as hand deformation and frame jitter are greatly reduced.
